title: Max builds a steel boat (it sank first)

beats.text: Max built a boat out of solid steel. It went straight down.
Let's see where it went wrong.
Max wants to take his kids across the lake, so he welds a big solid slab of steel.
Straight to the bottom. Steel is about eight times denser than water.
Same steel, shaped into a hollow hull. Now it pushes aside its own weight in water, and floats.
Max adds a tall cabin and a mast, climbs to the top, and the whole thing rolls over.
A heavy keel down low keeps the weight at the bottom, so it swings back upright.
Then one rivet pops. Water floods the whole hull, and Max bails as fast as he can.
Watertight walls split the hull into rooms, so a leak fills just one. A pump spits it back out.
But with no engine, the wind decides where they go. Into the reeds.
A propeller throws water backwards, which pushes the boat forwards, and the rudder steers.
Kids aboard, and across the lake they go. It floats, stays upright, and stays dry. Would you ride in Max's boat?

cta: Would you ride in Max's boat?
